title: LiteVLATrainingRecord
description: One supervised fine-tuning example: camera frame + instruction + discrete action (Epic 105 / VLA-41).

id.description: Unique record id within a dataset version.

image_path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path to an RGB/BGR image file (PNG/JPEG/WebP).

instruction.description: Natural-language goal shown to the VLA at training time.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the frame/action was captured.

episode_id.description: Groups rows from one capture session (teleop run or reference batch).

metadata.description: Optional capture context (sim stamps, velocities, world, review flags).
